patch_description: This uses an analytic symmetry-reduced construction instead of iterative random optimization. The 14 points are arranged as two staggered regular hexagons and two poles. The hexagons are rotated by 30 degrees, which distributes inter-layer contacts efficiently. Their radius and layer height are solved from contact equations so that the shortest same-ring and nearest cross-ring distances are equal, while the farthest cross-ring pairs equal the pole-to-pole diameter. This produces a highly balanced deterministic packing with no optimization-time overhead.
